mike: kicking off canary apply, will watch smoke jobs. leaving extra logging enabled.

sana: noted, holding change-window until 22:30 UTC in case we need to roll back. ping me if anything looks off.

deploybot: terraform apply COMPLETED — run=run-5532 · summary: 3 to add/modify, 0 failures · outputs: gpupool_id=gp-dc3-12 · applied_by=mike · plan=plan-7821

jess: quick smoke: image-puller failing on node dc3-02 and dc3-03, getting 403 from registry when pulling redwood/inference-worker:prod. logs: `pull access denied`

mike: hmm, only 2/3 nodes impacted. scaling back gpupool change to avoid impacting traffic. initiating rollback/pin to previous stable commit adf9caa.

infra-oncall: immediate note — switching critical routing to dc4 fallback while rollback runs :warning:

deploybot: terraform apply STARTED (rollback) — env=prod-dc3 · run=run-5533 · target_commit=adf9caa · reason="registry pull failures"

sana: good call. will monitor metrics and health checks, keep canary traffic disabled until cleared.

deploybot: terraform apply COMPLETED (rollback) — run=run-5533 · summary: 2 resources changed · status=success · pinned_to=adf9caa

jess: post-rollback smoke checks: all image-puller pods are now healthy on dc3-01..03, registry creds expired was root cause. opened INF-497 to rotate registry token and add alert.

mike: thanks everyone. tagging release v1.7.0 as ON_HOLD, will update release notes with rollback reason and follow-up actions.

infra-oncall: leaving this thread open until INF-497 is resolved and we confirm a safe reapply window. :white_check_mark:
